Usage: [command] [-h|--help] [--version]

Commands:
  analyze             Analyzes the resolved target and writes an AnalysisReport JSON. Use current-only mode for inventory and Git mode for change-aware review. Exit code 0 is process success, not a clean pass; read JSON verdict and completeness.
  codes describe      Describes one machine-readable code, including where it may appear and how it affects verdict interpretation, as CodeDescription JSON.
  codes list          Lists reserved machine-readable codes, their JSON locations, and verdict semantics as CodesCatalog JSON.
  diff                Compares the resolved current target with an explicit local Git revision and writes a DiffReport JSON. Exit code 0 is process success, not a clean pass; read JSON verdict and summary.
  doctor              Diagnoses target, workspace, rules, comparison, and generated-code prerequisites as a DoctorReport JSON. Exit code 1 can still include a usable report; read diagnostics for the next action.
  init                Creates or checks repository-local dotmet scaffold for .dotmet/local/ ignore settings. This command never creates .dotmet/rules.json or .dotmet/local/.
  rules create        Writes a repository-independent rules document skeleton. Allowed kind values are template and standard.
  rules graph         Writes a Mermaid flowchart for the dependency policy section of a valid rules file.
  rules schema        Writes the repository rules JSON Schema document without resolving a repository root, rules file, project, or workspace.
  rules validate      Validates a rules file without loading a workspace and writes a RulesValidationReport JSON. Validation failures use status ok, verdict fail, and exit code 1.
  skills doctor       Diagnoses installed Agent Skills.
  skills export       Exports Agent Skills.
  skills install      Installs Agent Skills.
  skills list         Lists Agent Skills.
  skills prune        Prunes removed Agent Skills.
  skills uninstall    Uninstalls Agent Skills.
  skills update       Updates Agen
[truncated]

result.stdout:
Usage: analyze [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Analyzes the resolved target and writes an AnalysisReport JSON. Use current-only mode for inventory and Git mode for change-aware review. Exit code 0 is process success, not a clean pass; read JSON verdict and completeness.

Options:
  --solutionPath <string?>              Solution target: .sln or .slnx file inside --repositoryRoot. Mutually exclusive with --projectPath. Omit both target options to auto-discover one target. [Default: null]
  --projectPath <string?>               Project target inside --repositoryRoot: .csproj file, .NET directory with one .sln/.slnx or .csproj, Unity project directory, or Godot project directory. Mutually exclusive with --solutionPath. [Default: null]
  --targetSet <string?>                 Target set JSON file inside --repositoryRoot. Mutually exclusive with --solutionPath, --projectPath, and explicit --targetKind values. Omit target options to use .dotmet/targets.json when present. [Default: null]
  --targetKind <TargetKind>             Allowed: auto, dotnet, unity, godot. auto detects the adapter from the resolved target; explicit values limit adapter selection to that kind. [Default: Auto]
  --rulesPath <string?>                 Rules JSON file path inside --repositoryRoot. Omit to use .dotmet/rules.json or built-in defaults; invalid explicit or discovered rules do not fall back. [Default: null]
  --repositoryRoot <string?>            Existing repository root directory. Omit to resolve from the selected target and current working directory. Relative report paths and repository-relative filters use this root. [Default: null]
  --comparisonMode <ComparisonMode>     Allowed: none, git. none runs current-only inventory; git requires --comparisonBase and adds change-aware review signals when that explicit base can be evaluated. [Default: None]
  --comparisonBase <string?>            Local Git revision used as the before source. Valid only with --comparisonMode git; dotmet does not fetch or mutate refs. [Default: null]
  --cacheM
[truncated]
